body:
### Renovate Ignore Notification

As this PR has been closed unmerged, Renovate will ignore this upgrade and you will not receive PRs for *any* future 21.x releases. However, if you upgrade to 21.x manually then Renovate will then reenable updates for minor and patch updates automatically.

If this PR was closed by mistake or you changed your mind, you can simply rename this PR and you will soon get a fresh replacement PR opened.
